news.title: 2026 NASPAA Global Conference
news.summary_en: The Paul H. O’Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs will showcase its leadership and collaborative spirit at the 2026 NASPAA Global Conference in Seattle, Washington, Sept. 30–Oct. 2.

news.title: Reyes-Erazo honored with NASPAA Pi Alpha Alpha Master’s Student Manuscript Award
news.summary_en: O’Neill MPA student Héctor Reyes-Erazo earns a national Pi Alpha Alpha award for research on California pension sustainability and intergenerational fiscal equity.
